title: Names Under Glass
invitation: Look for Ivo’s evidence beneath the gym.

panels.text: The last gym’s bells shake blue dust from Lugia’s window. One flake lands on a stretcher folded into the wall.

panels.speaker: Ina Quill
panels.text: Ivo brought me a carbon slip by the shelter path. The Recovery Service stamped his case closed before he reached this door.
The slip says EMPTY. Through the paper you can feel the dents where someone filled in the names on the sheet above.

choices.label: Hear the keeper’s account
choices.reply: Ina describes the tapping she heard from the cart. She signs the account. “Ask for disputed returns at Plateau registration.”
choices.clue: Keeper’s statement naming the crew and people on the open-circle manifest, with testimony that someone was alive inside the cart.

choices.label: Lift an impression of the names
choices.reply: The names surface under your pencil. Ina covers the impression. “Keep this dry until you reach Plateau registration.”
choices.clue: Carbon impression of the passenger names and the predated closure time.

echoes.text: Ina recognizes Ivo’s signature on the distress call. She copies his name to the file and keeps the other witnesses off the page.
Two hikers are warming their hands below the stairs. Ivo brought them in after your warning and left his slip under Ina’s kettle.

secret.title: Case Closed, Witness Present
secret.hint: Compare the Highcountry distress record with what you retained beneath the cathedral.
secret.text: Ivo’s relay call has a time stamp. The crew’s closure entry was already on file when he called. He could read his own case number while he was still in hiding.

title: The Intake Window
invitation: Read the Recovery Service’s accreditation file before entering the League.

panels.speaker: Registration loudspeaker
panels.text: Next challenger to the window. Keep the aisle clear.
Behind the registration desk, an Ultra Ball wedges open a drawer marked DISPUTED RETURNS.

panels.speaker: Orin Beck
panels.text: That’s our seal on their license. My predecessor logged the first complaint. The renewal went through with his file still in this drawer.
The League paid by closed case. A delivery marked EMPTY still earned the fee, so long as the open circle was stamped in the last column.

choices.label: Copy the clerk’s filing history
choices.reply: Orin copies the complaint and renewal. He writes the same answering address on each copy: Crucible service entrance.
choices.clue: Certified copies of a complaint and the later license renewal, with the disputed transfer number and intake total.

choices.label: Put the case on the public register
choices.reply: Orin calls out the inquiry number and the Crucible service entrance. A challenger in line takes out a pencil.
choices.clue: Public case receipt with the disputed transfer number, the League’s intake total, and the inquiry’s answering address.

echoes.text: Orin reads the keeper’s account again. He asks her permission to call it testimony before he adds a single word to the record.
The passenger names on your rubbing line up with unclaimed case numbers. Orin moves the file out of the unclaimed drawer.

secret.title: The Second Register
secret.hint: Look for the same transfer beneath the cathedral and inside the Plateau’s files.
secret.text: The cathedral slip and the League file contain different totals for the same cart. The smaller total leaves four people out. Next to their numbers someone wrote DO NOT NOTIFY.

title: On the Record
invitation: Meet Mara and Ivo by the service door.

panels.text: The roar in the Crucible drops to a murmur at the service door. Mara props it open with one of the old relay lamps. Ivo is already at the table.

panels.speaker: Ivo
panels.text: The first time they called me recovered, I was still in the cart. We got the three Pokémon out. Two people climbed out after me. Someone was still knocking when the driver pulled away.
Mara sets the intake number on the table. Ivo strikes through RECOVERED, writes PRESENT, and slides the pen to you. His hand has stopped shaking.

choices.label: Take his account in private
choices.reply: Ivo gives his account to Mara with the door shut. He takes the copy home. The other witnesses can decide for themselves when they’re ready.
choices.clue: Ivo’s signed account and transfer number, with the other witnesses’ names held privately.

choices.label: Witness his public statement
choices.reply: Ivo signs first. “My name. Let the other two tell it when they choose.” Mara counts the copies. He puts one in his own coat.
choices.clue: Ivo’s public correction to the Recovery record, filed under his own name.

echoes.text: Ivo lines up the renewal date with his stamped release. He wants every family to be able to point to what the League knew.
Someone from the Plateau queue posted the public case number. Two families have already left their names with Mara.

secret.title: An Answering Address
secret.hint: Keep evidence from the cathedral and the Plateau, then hear Ivo’s own account.
secret.text: One by one, your records put names against the four omitted numbers. Mara leaves a space for each family to answer. At the service door, someone knocks twice. Ivo gets up to take the first shift.
